item.title: Drake Seemingly Disses LeBron James With Shirt at Nocta Manor Retreat: ‘The Only LeBron I Rate Is Juan’
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: Welcome to Trending on Billboard, I'm your host. Today, we're diving into the latest news from the world of music and sports. You might be wondering, what do Drake and padel have in common? Well, let's find out.
[Soft music continues in the background]
Host: It turns out, Drake is a big fan of padel, a sport that's gaining popularity worldwide. Spanish professional padel player Juan Lebrón Chincoa, also known as "El Lobo" or "The Wolf", recently attended Drake's second annual Nike NOCTA retreat in Toronto. Chincoa even got to play a game with the rapper himself and showed his appreciation for the experience on Instagram.
[Short music transition]
Host: But what caught everyone's attention was a picture of a shirt with a bold statement: "The only LeBron I rate is Juan". This is a playful jab at NBA player LeBron James, with whom Drake had a falling-out in 2024. It seems like the feud is still ongoing, with Drake even posting a cryptic message on Instagram, referencing his past disagreements with Kendrick Lamar and LeBron James.
[Short music transition]
Host: Interestingly, former NBA player Tristan Thompson has been trying to get Drake and LeBron to reconcile their differences. With LeBron recently signing with the Philadelphia 76ers, it's likely that the two will cross paths more often, given that Drake's Toronto Raptors are in the same division.
[Outro music plays]
Host: That's all for today's episode of Trending on Billboard. Thanks for tuning in, and we'll catch you on the next one! [Outro music continues to play until the end]
